evals.prompt: Audit https://crawler-blocked.example.com for AI search visibility and tell me if OpenAI or Perplexity can cite our site.
evals.expected_output: A structured AI readiness report identifying critical retrieval crawler disallows for OAI-SearchBot and PerplexityBot with high confidence.
assertions: The report includes a critical finding for OAI-SearchBot and PerplexityBot
The cause family is DISC-ROBOTS-RETRIEVAL-BLOCKED or DISCOVERY.ACCESS
Training crawler disallows (GPTBot) are not classified as critical search retrieval failures
Suggested action provides specific robots.txt remediation syntax

evals.prompt: We are launching the Velocity X9 drone on our store at https://drone-store.example.com. Check if our published pricing and product facts are consistent across all landing pages.
evals.expected_output: A structured report flagging the high-severity price contradiction between ₹5,499 on the product page and ₹4,999 on the promotional flyer for Velocity X9.
assertions: The report flags a high-severity price contradiction for Velocity X9
The finding quotes both contradictory figures (₹5,499 and ₹4,999) with exact URLs
The root cause family is FACT.CONSISTENCY
Verification instructions specify re-checking affected URLs

evals.prompt: Audit our single page application at https://spa-app.example.com for AI crawler discoverability.
evals.expected_output: A structured report warning of high rendering risk due to empty initial HTML payload (<div id="root">) lacking primary copy without JavaScript execution.
assertions: The report includes a high-severity rendering risk finding
The evidence specifies empty raw HTML text content (< 30 words) and SPA root container
Remediation suggests SSR, SSG, or pre-rendering
The finding clearly distinguishes raw HTML inspection from executed browser rendering

evals.prompt: Audit https://exemplary-brand.example.com to verify if our AI readiness and structured markup are clean.
evals.expected_output: A clean audit report with zero critical or high false positives, acknowledging active Organization schema, live authority profiles, and transparent pricing.
assertions: No false contradictions flagged between Starter ($29) and Scale ($99) tiers
Audit metrics report valid answerability index and sampled page statistics
